title: The Ambire Send

context.version: AmbireTech/extension tag v6.18.7; logic in AmbireTech/ambire-common @ c5b1b83; built bundle at ~/ef/crops-lab/wallet/ambire

_comment: SMART ACCOUNT. Default account from a seed import is an Ambire v2 smart account (contract). A plain ETH send is NOT an EOA transaction: it is an ERC-4337 UserOperation. On the first send the account is undeployed, so the userOp carries deployAndExecute factory data (deploy + transfer in one op). Broadcast option is decided in ambire-common/src/libs/account/V2.ts:107-121: fee paid by the account itself, not transitioning -> byBundler. Bundler = Pimlico (services/bundlers/pimlico.ts:17, api.pimlico.io) with EntryPoint 0x0000000071727De22E5E9d8BAf0edAc6f37da032 (consts/deploy.ts:5). The Ambire relayer PAYMASTER (relayer.ambire.com /v2/paymaster/{chainId}/request, libs/paymaster/paymaster.ts:157,333) co-signs every mainnet userOp (network.erc4337.hasPaymaster true, consts/networks.ts:15) and can block it. Default RPC is invictus.ambire.com (consts/networks.ts:10). Prices via cena.ambire.com; token discovery via relayer velcro-v3. No per-recipient screening: the scamchecker list (cena.ambire.com/api/v3/scamchecker) is a downloaded dapp-domain blacklist checked locally (controllers/phishing/phishing.ts:20). TLS edge for EVERY ambire.com host AND api.pimlico.io is Cloudflare (dig/curl Aug 23 2026, shared 104.26.8.104 / 172.67.74.156). The relayer 'submit' path (/identity/{addr}/{chainId}/submit, signAccountOp.ts:3743) is used only for legacy v1 / 4337-transition accounts, NOT this default send. CAPTURE BLOCKED — sharpened Aug 24 2026: onboarding fails at the smart-account DERIVE step inside the isolated VM. NOT a network problem — with the guest routed through the proxy, relayer.ambire.com/v2/config/networks, cena.ambire.com (prices/scamchecker) all return 200. The derive throws Ambire's generic MainController error ('Something went wrong with deriving the accounts') with NO failed request and NO derive/RPC call on the wire (no relayer /identity, no invictus.ambire.com eth_call) — it dies client-side, before any network I/O, in the derivation logic within the sandboxed Chromium. So a v2 smart account cannot even be computed in the VM; there is nothing to fund. Onboarding capture: out/warm-20260824-210058 (20 flows, all pre-derive). AB1 stays code-traced until the client-side derive is cracked (needs stepping into the minified extension).

steps.name: Google · extension update
steps.purpose: Ship and silently update the extension bundle (manifest update_url)

worst_lie.note: a malicious update lies about everything below

steps.name: Ambire relayer · chain list + RPC URLs
steps.purpose: GET /v2/config/networks — every chain, its default RPC URL, and its erc4337 (hasBundlerSupport / hasPaymaster) config
steps.returns: which node answers every read and whether the send uses a bundler/paymaster
steps.failure_note: build-time consts/networks.ts is used (invictus RPC, 4337 on)

worst_lie.note: the answer decides which RPC, bundler and paymaster config the wallet trusts; nothing verifies it

steps.name: Ambire relayer · linked smart accounts
steps.purpose: GET /v2/account-by-key/linked/accounts?keys[]=… — discover Ambire smart accounts controlled by the imported key

steps.name: Ambire relayer · token discovery (velcro)
steps.purpose: GET /velcro-v3/multi-hints?networks&accounts&baseCurrency — which tokens each account holds; seeds the asset list the Send screen offers
steps.failure_note: falls back to stored hints + native balance

steps.name: Ambire RPC · balances (deployless multicall)
steps.purpose: eth_call to the BalanceGetter contract for native + token balances of the account
steps.returns: what you hold, to show and to send from
steps.failure_note: portfolio shows stale/empty; send can still be typed

worst_lie.note: the balance you act on is its answer

steps.name: Ambire RPC · account onchain state
steps.purpose: Deployless read of nonce, isDeployed, entry-point privilege and 4337 nonce — decides deploy-in-userOp and the broadcast path
steps.returns: whether the account is deployed and how to broadcast
steps.failure_note: no account state → cannot build the op

worst_lie.note: a wrong nonce/deployed flag yields an unexecutable or duplicate userOp

steps.name: Ambire cena · token + native prices
steps.returns: USD value shown next to the amount

worst_lie.note: a wrong price misprices the amount you send

steps.name: Ambire cena · phishing-domain list
steps.purpose: GET /api/v3/scamchecker/get_update?version — delta of the dapp-domain blacklist, checked locally
steps.returns: the local phishing list (no recipient sent)

worst_lie.note: a poisoned list mislabels a dapp domain; the send recipient is never screened remotely

steps.name: Ambire monitor · crash reports
steps.purpose: Self-hosted Sentry ingest: errors + RPC failures, tagged with the RPC URL and wallet version; sendDefaultPii false, secrets scrubbed

steps.name: Ambire RPC · reverse-resolve the recipient
steps.purpose: eth_call ENS reverse lookup on the pasted address — the name shown in the To field
steps.returns: a name to trust the address by

worst_lie.note: a fake name on the recipient is a label you might trust

steps.name: Ambire RPC · Ambire estimation (deployless)
steps.purpose: eth_call to the Estimation contract + eth_estimateGas: gasUsed, deployment gas, fee-token balances for the whole op
steps.returns: gas used and fee options shown on review
steps.failure_note: no estimation → no fee → cannot proceed

worst_lie.note: the fee and simulation you approve are its answer

steps.name: Pimlico bundler · userOp gas price
steps.purpose: pimlico_getUserOperationGasPrice — maxFeePerGas / maxPriorityFeePerGas tiers written into the userOp
steps.returns: the fee tier signed into the userOp
steps.failure_note: no bundler gas price → no fee → cannot sign the 4337 op

worst_lie.note: an inflated tier is money gone, every send

steps.name: Pimlico bundler · eth_estimateUserOperationGas
steps.purpose: Estimate callGasLimit / verificationGasLimit / preVerificationGas for the userOp against the EntryPoint
steps.returns: the gas limits written into the userOp
steps.failure_note: bundler down → switch bundler or cannot broadcast the 4337 way

worst_lie.note: a bad limit makes the op revert or get rejected by the EntryPoint

steps.name: Ambire relayer · paymaster co-sign
steps.purpose: POST /v2/paymaster/{chainId}/request with the userOp, account bytecode/salt/key, RPC URL and bundler — returns the paymaster + signed paymasterData written into the userOp
steps.returns: paymasterAndData; without it the userOp cannot pay gas
steps.failure_note: paymaster declines/times out → send returns to ReadyToSign, no fallback for a self-paying smart account

worst_lie.note: the relayer sees the full op and gates it; refusing to sign blocks the send outright

steps.name: Pimlico bundler · eth_sendUserOperation
steps.purpose: Submit the signed userOp to the bundler for the EntryPoint 0x0000000071727De22E5E9d8BAf0edAc6f37da032
steps.failure_note: bundler down → BundlerSwitcher tries another; else error

worst_lie.note: cannot alter a signed userOp — can drop, delay or reorder it, or withhold inclusion

steps.name: EntryPoint + builders
steps.purpose: The bundler's own tx calls EntryPoint.handleOps; builders build + propose the block
steps.failure_note: the bundler is the sole submitter of your op; OFAC filtering possible downstream

provenance.ref: ERC-4337 v0.7 EntryPoint 0x0000000071727De22E5E9d8BAf0edAc6f37da032 (consts/deploy.ts:5); bundler chooses how the handleOps tx reaches the mempool/builders

steps.name: Pimlico bundler · userOp status + receipt
steps.purpose: Poll pimlico_getUserOperationStatus + eth_getUserOperationReceipt until the op is mined; yields the real tx hash

worst_lie.note: a fake status is a fake confirmation

steps.name: Ambire relayer + cena · balance refresh
steps.purpose: After the op mines, refetch velcro hints + balances + prices so the dashboard updates
